engine_name: Goal Weight Timeline: goal BMI floor of 18.5 (1 dp, half-up) for every background, safe weekly rate cap min(1.0 kg, 1 % of current weight rounded to 2 dp) with 0.25 and 0.5 kg a week only at age 65+, weeks to goal = ceil((current - goal) / rate), target date = today + 7 x weeks, 5 % first milestone, daily deficit 1100 x rate kcal handed to the calorie calculator, implied-rate check when a date is given instead, and a safety layer that stops before any number for under-18s, pregnancy or breastfeeding and eating disorders
intended_use: Free tool, used inside goal setting (FR3-09) and as a standalone calculator, that checks a weight-loss goal against a healthy BMI floor and a safe weekly rate, then shows the weeks to goal, the target date, the weekly targets for the first 4 weeks and the 5 % milestone. The same safe-rate rule and BMI floor apply to every weight goal on the site (goal setting, check-ins, plan adjustments). General information, not a medical device. It never shows a calorie number (the calorie calculator does) and never a badge for kilograms lost. Loss and maintain goals only at launch (D3-08); goal reached means the 7-day mean weight is at or below the goal (D3-09).
eligibility: Adults aged 18 to 99 with a goal weight below their current weight (equal means maintain, and the Keep It Off track is offered instead of a timeline). Stops with no numbers for under-18s, pregnancy or breastfeeding (Yes or Not sure) and an eating disorder (Yes, or the profile flag; a member with the flag cannot create a weight goal at all). 'Prefer not to say' on the eating-disorder question limits the rate to 0.25 or 0.5 with 'about' wording and no 'fastest' option. Goal BMI below 18.5 is refused with the lowest healthy weight offered; current BMI below 18.5 gets no loss timeline and the underweight wording from the Healthy Weight Check. Age 65+ is offered 0.25 and 0.5 kg a week only, with the muscle-preservation note from P3-55.
sources: NICE CG189 (2014, updated 2023) section 1.7: aim for 0.5-1 kg a week; 5-10 % loss is clinically meaningful.
NHS Better Health: safe weight loss 0.5-1 kg (1-2 lb) a week.
CDC Healthy Weight: 1-2 lb a week.
NHMRC (Australia) Clinical practice guidelines for the management of overweight and obesity (2013).
ACSM position stand (2009) and Hall KD et al. Lancet 2011 (energy-balance dynamics, plateaus).
NICE NG246 (2025) BMI thresholds; WHO BMI classification (healthy range from 18.5).
Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group. NEJM 2002;346:393-403 (7 % loss target).
limitations: Linear estimate: weight loss is not a straight line, plateaus and water-weight swings are expected, and the real trend is checked every week.
Not for pregnancy or breastfeeding, under-18s or eating disorders.
Self-reported measurements; the lower BMI bound of 18.5 is the same for every family background, so the background question is not asked.
Gain goals are not offered at launch (D3-08); maintain and loss only.
regulatory_statement: Approved by the owner as clinical reviewer on 3 November 2026 (NFR3-14; decisions D3-07 to D3-09). General health information, not a diagnosis or a medical device.
licence: Lifeline Daily's own implementation of the published NICE, NHS and CDC safe weight-loss range and WHO BMI threshold.
